images.title: Steeper means a bigger change
images.purpose: Shows the United States line for 2022 to 2024: a steep rise of about 280, then a gentle rise of about 30.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One short line of two segments on a light grid, the steep segment highlighted.
images.exact_structure: A light grey (#6B7280) grid with a horizontal axis carrying three ticks labelled 2022, 2023 and 2024 and an unlabelled vertical axis. Three dark points joined by two straight segments: about 1950 in 2022, about 2230 in 2023, about 2260 in 2024. The first segment, 2022 to 2023, is thick and reddish purple (#CC79A7) with the tag about +280 beside it and the word steeper. The second segment, 2023 to 2024, is teal (#0072B2), almost flat, with the tag about +30. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The steeper the segment, the bigger the change.
images.description: Shows the United States line for 2022 to 2024: a steep rise of about 280, then a gentle rise of about 30.
images.context: United States objects launched into space, approximate values read from the graph.

image_decisions.why: Isolating two segments makes steepness the only thing to compare.
